name: SFWBar
summary: Flexible Wayland taskbar with window list, pager, tray, volume, network, Bluetooth and a start menu
description: SFWBar (S* Floating Window Bar) is a taskbar for Wayland compositors with a focus on stacking layouts, but it works under Hyprland too. It offers a Windows-style grouped taskbar, pager, alt-tab switcher, system tray, volume, keyboard layout, network and Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, notifications, MPD control, clock, power and idle controls, and a scripting language for building your own widgets.
